Ticket Master is an NPC located in various Locations around the Dwarven Mines that allows players to easily travel around the Dwarven Mines at a cost. The cost of the minecart ride is calculated by multiplying the distance to the destination by 2x.

Contents

  • 1 Interface
  • 2 Dialogue
  • 3 History
  • 4 Navigation

Interface

[edit | edit source]
Dwarven Mines Rail System

Dialogue

[edit | edit source]
Condition Random Dialogue
Purchasing a Ride
[NPC] Ticket Master: Hop on in and I'll get you going!
[NPC] Ticket Master: Hop in and we'll be off!
[NPC] Ticket Master: See that empty, weak metal box? Good! That's your cart, hop in!
[NPC] Ticket Master: Hold tight, it's going to be a bump ride!
[NPC] Ticket Master: Thanks for choosing Dwarven Mine Co. - we operate 24/7 across the whole mine!
[NPC] Ticket Master: Now, please climb aboard before your cart leaves without you.
[NPC] Ticket Master: Again.
[NPC] Ticket Master: Let's a go!
[NPC] Ticket Master: Ever been in one of these before? No?
[NPC] Ticket Master: Well...
[NPC] Ticket Master: I'm sure you'll be fine!
[NPC] Ticket Master: Last guy who was in this cart didn't feel too well so watch out he might have left a surprise in there.
Missed Minecart
[NPC] Ticket Master: Quickly now the Minecart is leaving!
[NPC] Ticket Master: Oh no! It looks like you missed the Minecart!
Arriving
[NPC] Ticket Master: Welcome to the <location>!
Traveling to Hanging Court
[NPC] Ticket Master: Off to the court? I would tell you to talk to the King but I don't know who he is anymore...
[NPC] Ticket Master: Did you know the Court is almost as old as the throne room, it's got some lovely flower beds too!
Traveling to Gates to the Mines
[NPC] Ticket Master: See those statues? They are the former Kings, Bunumir Ironbeard and Skordous Pebblebeard, guarding the entrance to the mines.
Traveling to Aristocrat Passage
[NPC] Ticket Master: Aristocrat passage ey? Best of luck to you.
Traveling to Forge Basin
[NPC] Ticket Master: Did you know that the Forge is so big it has to have multiple forging stations.
Traveling to Goblin Burrows
[NPC] Ticket Master: You ever seen those Goblins? Some say they lay eggs. How weird.
[NPC] Ticket Master: Goblin's are not the only creatures that dwell here. Rumor has it dirt monsters linger in these parts too...
None
[NPC] Ticket Master: I once stumbled upon a hidden lake in these parts, Some unsavory characters living there robbed me of all my gold!
[NPC] Ticket Master: You came down the lift? I never thought you could get this far down! Someone should have called this place the Deeper Caverns!
[NPC] Ticket Master: Hey, if you find any Titanium down here let me know! I wanted to buy some of that stuff for a new pickaxe.
